Security & Privacy Benefits

One of the significant advantages of using free loan calculators is the security and privacy benefits they offer. Unlike traditional financial software, free loan calculators use client-side processing, which means that all calculations are performed on your device, without sending any sensitive information to a server. This approach ensures that your financial data remains private and secure.

US Compliance

In the United States, financial institutions and software providers must comply with various regulations, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). Free loan calculators, such as those offered by Tech Resolutions, are designed to comply with these regulations, ensuring that your financial data is protected and secure.
